verdict.rationale: An official SDK story is a fair axis for a GPU platform. The evidence only shows adjacent first-party software: the NVIDIA Container Toolkit with Docker Engine, GPU administration and health-monitoring software, and the nvidia-smi tool, plus vague claims about arming developers on a single platform. No developer SDK for building applications is named. Missing for 10: any explicit official SDK (e.g., a compute/AI programming SDK) with API docs, language bindings or versioning info, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against it.
